notes:
- feat(auth): verify a candidate's face at sign-in, compared locally against a reference portrait the administrator sets
- feat(auth): keep the face comparison entirely on the candidate's machine — no image, no score and no record leaves the browser during a check
- feat(ui): show the check as a modal over the exam window, with Try again and Cancel
- feat(auth): hand each session its own signing key at sign-in, so only the registered integration's server can read the result
- feat(auth): serve the reference portrait over a signed fetch, capped at 10 MiB and 24 megapixels
- fix(ui): keep the face modal's focus ring visible on keyboard navigation
- feat(ui): confirm a passed check with "Face matched. Confirming…" until the server grants the login, then show "Verified"
- feat(auth): integrate as a partner with three small pieces — a login header check, one check URL, and two lines on the page — the same contract on every platform
